<style>
:root {
  --ltf-canvas-dark: #00001C;
  --ltf-text-pure: #FFFFFF;
  --ltf-bg-secondary: #06142E;
  --ltf-text-secondary: #E5E5E5;
  --ltf-accent-med-navy: #263350;
  --ltf-accent-teal: #1F7781;
  --ltf-accent-green: #0B8050;
  --ltf-accent-purple: #4D259D;
}
.ltf-3d-canvas-wrapper { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #1F7781 0%, #4D259D 50%, transparent 72%); filter: blur(90px); }
.ltf-gallery-item-bg { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #263350 0%, rgba(31,119,129,0.12) 100%); }
.ltf-gallery-item-tag { background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,28,0.85), transparent); }
.ltf-funnel-cta-glow { background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #4D259D 0%, #1F7781 45%, transparent 72%); filter: blur(110px); }
.ltf-upsell-list-item::before { content: '\25AA'; color: #1F7781; font-size: 12px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-right: 16px; }
.ltf-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1F7781, #4D259D); border-color: transparent; }
.ltf-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: rgba(31,119,109,0.1); color: #FFFFFF; }
.ltf-funnel-cta:hover .ltf-funnel-cta-glow { opacity: 0.2; }
.ltf-funnel-cta:hover .ltf-funnel-cta-inner { border-color: rgba(31,119,129,0.45); }
.ltf-upsell-list-item:hover { background: rgba(31,119,129,0.08); }
.ltf-gallery-item:hover { border-color: rgba(31,119,129,0.4); }
.ltf-specs-vault-sticky::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 32px; right: 80px; width: 1px; height: 48px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(31,119,129,0.6), transparent); animation: ltf-scroll-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes ltf-scroll-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scaleY(1); } 50% { opacity: 1; transform: scaleY(1.2); } }
.ltf-authority-text-box { transition: background 0.35s ease, border-color 0.4s ease; }
.ltf-authority-text-box::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle 300px at var(--ax, 50%) var(--ay, 50%), rgba(31,119,129,0.14), rgba(77,37,157,0.07) 55%, transparent 75%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s ease; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0; }
.ltf-authority-text-box:hover { background: rgba(31,119,129,0.05); border-color: rgba(31,119,129,0.28); }
.ltf-authority-text-box:hover::before { opacity: 1; }
.ltf-authority-text-box > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.ltf-authority-image-box { transition: border-color 0.4s ease; }
.ltf-authority-image-box:hover { border-color: rgba(31,119,129,0.28); }
@media screen and (max-width: 991px) {
  .ltf-spec-card { left: 32px; right: 32px; padding-left: 52px; padding-right: 52px; }
  .ltf-gallery-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-rows: auto; }
  .ltf-gallery-item { min-height: 240px; }
  .ltf-gallery-item:first-child { grid-column: 1 / 3; }
  .ltf-authority-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
  .ltf-upsell-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 48px; }
  .ltf-funnel-cta-inner { padding: 64px 44px; }
}
@media screen and (max-width: 767px) {
  .ltf-hero, .ltf-gallery, .ltf-authority, .ltf-upsell, .ltf-funnel-cta { padding-left: 24px; padding-right: 24px; }
  .ltf-spec-card { left: 16px; right: 16px; top: 16px; bottom: 16px; padding-left: 32px; padding-right: 32px; padding-top: 48px; padding-bottom: 48px; }
  .ltf-gallery-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: auto; }
  .ltf-gallery-item { min-height: 220px; }
  .ltf-gallery-item:first-child { grid-column: 1; }
  .ltf-funnel-cta-inner { padding: 52px 32px; }
}
@media screen and (max-width: 479px) {
  .ltf-hero, .ltf-gallery, .ltf-authority, .ltf-upsell, .ltf-funnel-cta { padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; }
  .ltf-spec-card { left: 12px; right: 12px; top: 12px; bottom: 12px; padding-left: 24px; padding-right: 24px; padding-top: 36px; padding-bottom: 36px; }
  .ltf-funnel-cta-inner { padding: 40px 24px; }
  .ltf-upsell-list-item { font-size: 13px; padding-top: 16px; padding-bottom: 16px; padding-left: 18px; padding-right: 18px; }
}
</style>
<style>
/* Apparel landing — hero + page nav overrides (append to page head) */

:root {
  --ltf-accent-teal-light: #2AAAB8;
  --ltf-accent-purple-mid: #7040C0;
  --ltf-nebula-gradient: linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    var(--ltf-accent-purple),
    var(--ltf-accent-teal-light),
    var(--ltf-accent-teal),
    var(--ltf-accent-green),
    var(--ltf-accent-purple-mid),
    var(--ltf-accent-purple)
  );
  --ltf-shadow-50: 0 5px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
}

/* ── Page nav (not global) ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ltf-site-nav {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  width: 100%;
  height: 52px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.ltf-nav-inner {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 100%;
  max-width: 1440px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 clamp(20px, 3vw, 48px);
}

.ltf-nav-brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  text-decoration: none;
  opacity: 0.95;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.ltf-nav-brand:hover { opacity: 1; }

.ltf-nav-brand img {
  height: 28px;
  width: auto;
  display: block;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35));
}

.ltf-nav-links {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(20px, 3vw, 40px);
}

.ltf-nav-link {
  font-family: 'acumin-pro-condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--ltf-text-pure);
  opacity: 0.88;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.ltf-nav-link:hover { opacity: 1; }

.ltf-nav-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}

.ltf-nav-btn-contact,
.ltf-nav-btn-quote {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 7px 26px;
  background: var(--ltf-text-pure);
  color: var(--ltf-bg-secondary);
  font-family: 'acumin-pro-condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  text-decoration: none;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
  border-radius: 3px;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease;
}

/* ── Hero layout sync with preview ───────────────────────────────────── */
.ltf-hero {
  margin-top: -52px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.ltf-rock-stage,
.ltf-3d-canvas-wrapper.ltf-rock-stage {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.ltf-rock-stage canvas {
  display: block;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
}

.ltf-hero-figure,
.ltf-hero-figure-img {
  position: absolute;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  width: clamp(200px, 33.75vw, 488px);
  height: auto;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: translateX(2%);
  filter: drop-shadow(-28px 0 56px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6));
}

.ltf-hero-content,
.ltf-hero-headline {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(50% - 125px);
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.ltf-main-header {
  transform: scaleX(0.88);
  transform-origin: center center;
}

.div-block-37,
.ltf-hero-bottom-bar {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 48px;
  left: 58px;
  z-index: 3;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 28px;
  width: 500px;
  max-width: calc(100vw - 96px);
  pointer-events: none;
  background: transparent !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}

.div-block-37 .ltf-body-text,
.div-block-37 .ltf-hero-footer-copy {
  font-size: clamp(20px, 1.15vw, 22px);
  line-height: 1.45;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ── Nebula gradient button ring ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 2px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  background: transparent;
  transition: box-shadow 0.35s ease;
  pointer-events: auto;
}

.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap:hover,
.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap:focus-within,
.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active {
  background: var(--ltf-nebula-gradient);
  background-size: 200% 200%;
  animation: ltf-nebula-gradient-shift 3s linear infinite;
  box-shadow:
    0 0 16px rgba(77, 37, 157, 0.45),
    0 0 28px rgba(31, 119, 129, 0.28);
}

.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active {
  animation-duration: 1.8s;
}

@keyframes ltf-nebula-gradient-shift {
  0%   { background-position: 0% 50%; }
  50%  { background-position: 100% 50%; }
  100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
}

.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap > .ltf-btn-primary,
.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap > .ltf-nav-btn-contact,
.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap > .ltf-nav-btn-quote {
  display: inline-flex;
}

.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap > .ltf-nav-btn-contact,
.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap > .ltf-nav-btn-quote {
  border: none;
}

.div-block-37 .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap > .ltf-btn-primary,
.ltf-hero-bottom-bar .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap > .ltf-btn-primary {
  border: 1px solid var(--ltf-text-pure);
}

.div-block-37 .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap:hover > .ltf-btn-primary,
.ltf-hero-bottom-bar .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap:hover > .ltf-btn-primary,
.div-block-37 .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active > .ltf-btn-primary,
.ltf-hero-bottom-bar .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active > .ltf-btn-primary {
  border-color: transparent;
}

.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap:hover > .ltf-btn-primary,
.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active > .ltf-btn-primary {
  background: var(--ltf-bg-secondary);
  color: var(--ltf-text-pure);
}

.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap:hover > .ltf-nav-btn-contact,
.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap:hover > .ltf-nav-btn-quote,
.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active > .ltf-nav-btn-contact,
.ltf-btn-gradient-wrap.ltf-btn-gradient-active > .ltf-nav-btn-quote {
  background: var(--ltf-text-pure);
  border-color: transparent;
}

/* Override legacy page hover on hero CTA when gradient wrap is used */
.div-block-37 .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap .ltf-btn-primary:hover,
.ltf-hero-bottom-bar .ltf-btn-gradient-wrap .ltf-btn-primary:hover {
  background: var(--ltf-bg-secondary);
  border-color: transparent;
}

</style>
